0022600085.text: Both the Orlando Magic and Atlanta Hawks open their 2026-27 seasons in this game, with the Magic at home, and ESPN's matchup predictor gives Orlando a 55% chance to win. The Hawks won all four meetings in the 2025-26 season, including the most recent one, a 130-101 Atlanta win in Orlando on April 1, 2026, and no games have been played yet this season. Orlando is without Izaiyah Nelson (ankle surgery) and Noah Penda (hamstring), and Anthony Black, Franz Wagner, Jase Richardson and Jonathan Isaac are listed as day-to-day with game-time decisions, while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
